column7: SURFACE REMOVED (ADR-108 Phase 6 step 14c-2): proving test TestMarkTOTPStepUsedProxy_StepFarInFuture_Rejected deleted along with MarkTOTPStepUsedProxy (the /system POST mfa/totp-step-used relay route) this clock-skew bound protected. Confirmed (internal/core/mfa.go, ActivateMFA/VerifyMFACredentials) the local, non-proxy path never had this vulnerability shape to begin with: it calls c.storage.MarkTOTPStepUsed(ctx, userID, step) with step always internally computed by validateTOTPStep(secret, code) from a real cryptographic TOTP check, never accepted as a raw wire field the way the deleted proxy route did. See docs/findings/2026-09-23-FINDING-active-transition-admin-rank-totp-step-bound.md for the original finding.
